entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The deep-claim Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim*, with its static game and no database.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim/.
entities.deployedBy: By hand: the owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs `npm run deploy` in games/deep-claim (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates, and a Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys on a merge to main; the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
The owner's say-so: only the owner, or an agent the owner asks, deploys.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and deploy it again by hand with `npm run deploy`.
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview URLs are off, so production is the only address.

sources.symbol: Install Godot and its web export templates
